subject: MAP: Test-case provisioning schedule, prompt-pack delivery & usage constraints
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@brightanalytics.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightanalytics.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + dataset / prompt pack handoff

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the rollout options. Procurement suggested we get the MAP and evaluation artifacts staged so legal and data science can run through the tests before EOW.

Two asks to confirm:
1) Can Redwood provide a sealed prompt pack (prompt templates + test cases) and a small, representative test corpus (anonymized) by Tue 30 Nov? We need those artifacts to validate accuracy regressions and to finalize acceptance criteria.
2) Are there standard usage constraints / licensing terms you attach to evaluation materials? Our legal team needs to know what we can and cannot do with the test data and prompts (e.g., no redistribution, retention period, allowed analysis).

If useful, I can send over a short MAP draft with our target milestones & decision gates. We’re trying to keep the evaluation window tight so the Q4 close can proceed.

Best,
Elena

Head of Data Science | Bright Analytics
elena@brightanalytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@brightanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + dataset / prompt pack handoff

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. We can absolutely support a tight evaluation cadence. High level plan below; I’ll attach a short MAP PDF and the prompt pack by COB Mon (we’ll push the test corpus as an encrypted bundle once the NDA is in place).

Proposed immediate milestones (short MAP):
- Mon 30 Nov — Redwood delivers: sealed prompt pack (v1), MAP (milestones & acceptance criteria), and initial test-case index.
- Tue 1 Dec — Bright runs smoke evals; provide feedback + top 5 failure cases.
- Wed 2 Dec — Joint sync to review results and agree on go/no-go criteria for pilot.
- Thu 3 Dec — If accepted, Redwood provisions a 2-week dedicated eval pool (Dedicated trial) with monitored telemetry; otherwise iterate on failing test cases.

Usage constraints / standard terms (summary):
- Evaluation-only license: artifacts provided for evaluation of Redwood services; no redistribution to third parties.
- Retention: Bright may retain artifacts for 90 days post-delivery for analysis; beyond that we require either deletion certification or written consent.
- Reporting: Bright may publish aggregate performance numbers but must not disclose example prompts or test outputs that could identify proprietary customer data.
- Security: test corpus will be delivered encrypted; keys exchanged via our KMS/DocuSign flow.

Attachments in next email: MAP-2026-11-30.pdf, bright_eval_prompt_pack_v1.zip (sealed), NDA-Bright-Redwood_signed.pdf (we will send signed copy once countersigned by your legal).

I’m looping Rishi for technical packaging notes and Marissa for legal / eval tooling & tracking.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0143

Attachment: MAP-2026-11-30.pdf (will follow), bright_eval_prompt_pack_v1.zip (planned)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Elena Soto <elena@brightanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 07:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Test-case provisioning schedule, prompt-pack delivery & usage constraints

Laura / Elena — quick technical notes so the delivery is consumable by Bright DS: 
- Prompt pack format: zipped folder with a README, prompt_templates.md (annotated), test_cases.csv (id, input, expected_output, tolerance_flags), and a small evaluation harness (python) with example eval commands.
- Corpus: anonymized JSONL with < 5k rows (sampled), will be encrypted (AES-256) and signed. We will provide the decryption key via a one-time KMS token.
- Labels / expected outputs: soft labels included; recommend running with Redwood’s eval-harness v0.9 to match our scoring. We will include an eval config (sequence length, sampling params) so your results align with our CI.
- Allowed usage: evaluation, debugging, and internal model-compatibility testing only. No re-training or embedding retention beyond 90 days. If Bright needs longer retention or training license we can add that to the SOW.

Operational notes: please confirm the email address to receive the encrypted bundle and whether procurement prefers a DocuSign link or an emailed signed NDA.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: bright_eval_prompt_pack_v1.zip (contains prompt_templates.md, test_cases.csv, eval_harness.py)

We have also uploaded the encrypted test corpus; procurement: I’m sending NDA-Bright-Redwood_signed.pdf to procurement@brightanalytics.com and the DocuSign link for countersignature: https://docusign.com/somewhere/abc123 (please note link expires in 7 days).
